issues: The predicted outcome implies that W53Ta42V5 has less prevalent voids than both baselines, but the tabulated void areal density for W53Ta42V5 (8.3×10^-2 nm^-2) is higher than for V-free W44Ta56 (1.8×10^-2 nm^-2).
The answer appropriately notes that the paper's claim of an order-of-magnitude density reduction from 3 to 5 at.% V is inconsistent with the tabulated values; the reduction is only about 36%.
